themes.description: Rare, naturally occurring metallic elements with high economic value, such as gold, silver, and platinum, used in jewelry, investment, and industrial applications.

linked_companies.description: Engages in the extensive exploration, extraction, and processing of gold, silver, and other precious metals across a global portfolio of mining assets, serving as a primary supplier of these commodities to the market.
linked_companies.evidence: Newmont operates primarily around precious metals extraction, generating 1.3 million ounces of gold and 9 million ounces of silver during the first quarter of 2026. Guided by operations across Cadia, Yanacocha, and Peñasquito, the company maintains the industry's largest gold reserves and officially ranks as the world's third-largest silver producer. Gold and silver outputs drive the majority of Newmont's financial performance, supported by billions in combined quarterly sales and a $1.4 billion full-year development budget explicitly targeting precious metal asset expansions. Executive leadership and organizational structures are firmly aligned with this focus, deploying dedicated underground site personnel and cross-functional operational expertise to fulfill a full-year production target of 5.3 million ounces of gold.
linked_companies.name: NEWMONT CORP

linked_companies.description: Acquires and manages precious metal stream and royalty interests, providing capital to mining operators in exchange for a share of future gold, silver, and other precious metal production.
linked_companies.evidence: Royal Gold's overarching business strategy relies entirely on precious metals, which recently constituted 87% of its total revenue through a 71% and 16% split between gold and silver streams. To expand this core pillar, management executes large-scale capital allocations, expanding its revolving credit facility to $2 billion to support major acquisitions like the Kansanshi and Sandstorm gold streams, alongside a $100 million commitment to secure noncore precious metals at the Warintza project. This specialized streaming and royalty framework structurally insulates the firm from direct operating cost inflation, securing its self-reported position as having the highest gold revenue concentration among its large-cap peers.
linked_companies.name: ROYAL GOLD INC

linked_companies.description: Operates as a primary producer of precious metals, focusing on the exploration, extraction, and development of silver and gold mining properties.
linked_companies.evidence: Hecla Mining operates exclusively as an extractor of precious metals, structurally positioned as North America's premium silver producer. The company derives approximately 87% of its total sales from this industry, with silver accounting for 73% of revenue and gold contributing the remainder through byproduct sales at sites like Greens Creek. Executive leadership directs the firm's capital directly into precious metal expansion, highlighted by a recent $40 to $50 million investment in a silver and gold recovery circuit at Greens Creek, alongside advanced drilling campaigns at the Aurora and Midas projects. This operational alignment, further reinforced by the strategic divestment of the Casa Berardi mine to concentrate on primary silver assets, dictates the company's entire business strategy and resource allocation.
linked_companies.name: HECLA MINING CO

linked_companies.description: Engages in the exploration, development, and extraction of gold and silver across multiple mining assets, directly contributing to the global supply of precious metals.
linked_companies.evidence: Coeur Mining defines its foundational corporate identity as a strictly North American-only precious metals platform, structuring its entire workforce and executive leadership around gold and silver extraction. The company recently advanced this strategy through the high-impact integration of New Gold, adding the New Afton and Rainy River mines to drive an expected 80% year-over-year increase in 2026 gold production to approximately 750,000 ounces. Coupled with output levels that place the company among the top five global silver producers, precious metals act as an absolute pure-play driver for the business, generating up to 98% of its total consolidated sales revenue.
linked_companies.name: COEUR MINING INC

linked_companies.description: Focuses on the exploration, extraction, and processing of primary silver and gold, driving the global supply of precious metals through its active mining operations and development projects.
linked_companies.evidence: Fresnillo's business model is entirely dedicated to the extraction of precious metals, operating as the world's largest primary silver producer and Mexico's largest gold producer across eight active mines. In the first quarter of 2026, the company reported production of 11.12 million ounces of silver and 136,074 ounces of gold, maintaining a full-year gold production guidance of 500,000 to 550,000 ounces. To sustain this market leadership and support ongoing extraction, Fresnillo is investing heavily in physical infrastructure, such as the commissioning of phase XV leaching pads at Herradura and the Jarillas shaft at Saucito, alongside active workforce expansion and optimization initiatives.
linked_companies.name: FRESNILLO PLC

linked_companies.description: Drives the global supply of copper through extensive exploration, extraction, and processing operations at major mining assets worldwide.
linked_companies.evidence: Freeport-McMoRan explicitly defines its strategic mandate and organizational structure around copper extraction, positioning itself as "America's copper champion" and a leading global supplier. This foundational focus dictates the company's capital allocation, with $4.3 billion to $4.5 billion in annual capital expenditures dedicated to major mining expansions at assets like the Bagdad, El Abra, and Grasberg Block Cave facilities. Operations across dedicated regional divisions in the U.S., South America, and Indonesia enable the company to dominate production, supplying 70% of the U.S. refined copper market. Consequently, copper mining drives the vast majority of consolidated revenues, generating a financial model so heavily leveraged to the commodity that every $0.10 per pound price fluctuation equates to a $400 million shift in annual EBITDA.
linked_companies.name: FREEPORT-MCMORAN INC

linked_companies.description: Drives global copper production through extensive mining, smelting, and refining operations, supplying critical resources essential for widespread industrial and commercial applications.
